'''Sal Sor'Chan''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as an [[Jedi Ambassador|advisor]] and [[Recruitment Agent|recruiter]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==Personality and traits==
Sal Sor'Chan believed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was evil and tyrannical, but thought the majority of its people were simply ignorant to its evil. As a recruiting agent for the Rebellion, she worked to see the Empire defeated by showing its citizenry the error of their ways. Sor'Chan firmly believed mercy was a source of strength and would rather spare the life of an enemy than kill.<ref name="FD BETA" />

Like all Nautolans, Sor'Chan was [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] and could breathe both under water and on land. She wore armored clothing and carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Shock glove/Legends|shock gloves]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and disguise kit. She had a [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoo]] of the [[Alliance Starbird|Rebel crest]] hidden somewhere on her body.<ref name="FD BETA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zora appears as an introductory character for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny|''Force and Destiny'']] [[roleplaying game]] [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beta|Beta]].<ref name="FD BETA" />
